messages:
elaine_support: Hey @jordan_customer — I see your ACH to Midtown Learning (acct ending *4321) returned this morning. Sorry about that. Can you share the receiving bank ABA you used?

jordan_customer: Hi Elaine — I pasted the ABA from the invoice: 011000138. It failed with 'returned: R02 incorrect routing number'. We need this resolved ASAP; payroll delayed.

payments-bot: ACH return received - Trace 987654321012345 - Return Code R02 - Notice: 'Incorrect transit routing number'. Originating FI returned the entry.

mike_payments: I pulled the return file. Looks like the ABA sent was `011000138` but vendor profile stores `010000138` (single digit transposed). That would produce R02.

alice_ops: Which file did this come from? prod payroll job `payroll-2026-03-15-run-14`. If we re-initiate ACH we'll need updated authorization. Wire is an option if they need immediate funds.

jordan_customer: Ugh, we copied the ABA from their vendor portal. I'll reach out to the vendor treasury now and confirm. Do you need any docs from our side?

mike_payments: If vendor confirms correct ABA we can either: 1) resubmit ACH after they provide a quick written confirmation (email ok) and you update the stored bank details, or 2) ops can escalate for a manual wire (fee applies). If you want us to hold any retry, say 'hold'.

elaine_support: Marking case CS-2026-1123 and flagging as P1 for payroll impact. Jordan, please DM me the vendor confirmation when you have it. I'll coordinate with @mike_payments and @alice_ops. :thumbsup:

jordan_customer: Will do. Thanks everyone.

mike_payments: For records, pasted the transaction snippet:
```
File: payroll-2026-03-15-run-14.ach
Entry Trace: 987654321012345
RDFI Routing: 011000138
Stored Vendor ABA: 010000138
Return Code: R02
```

alice_ops: Noted. I'll prepare wire PR template in case Jordan requests it. Keep me posted.

elaine_support: Closing for now pending vendor confirmation — re-open when you DM the updated ABA or ask for wire.
